Introduction

FriA was a South Korean virtual group under TA Entertainment. The group consisted of three members: Beberry, Bombing, and Go Summer. They debuted on December 23, 2023, with the single "FRIA 1st X-mas."

Originally debuting with four members, Blovey left the group on March 20, 2024 due to controversy. The group officially ended its activities on January 18, 2025.
